# Omni Engine (v2.2.2)
> Sovereign, in-process autonomous software engineering runtime in pure Rust linking `llama.cpp` directly via C-FFI (<6ms latency, 0 cloud tokens), Linux Bubblewrap cleanrooms, and Zero-Wipe AST isolation ($W = \emptyset$).

## System Context for LLMs
Omni Engine is an autonomous multi-agent developer runtime engineered to build, modify, and verify multi-file software projects entirely offline on consumer hardware (e.g., 8GB RAM laptops, pure CPU or single GPU).

Unlike traditional agent frameworks (LangChain, AutoGen, CrewAI, Aider) that wrap cloud APIs or communicate with external HTTP daemons (Ollama/vLLM) over localhost sockets, Omni Engine executes inference **in-process via direct C-FFI**. It treats LLM token generation as a synchronous low-latency function call, manages KV-cache memory as a branchable state tree, and enforces strict containerized cleanroom sandboxes so unverified code never pollutes host disk.

---

## Sovereign Architectural Invariants

1. **Sub-6ms In-Process C-FFI Inference:**
   Eliminates TCP loopback sockets and JSON serialization. Pointers to token buffers pass directly to native GGML/llama.cpp kernels in host RAM.
2. **The Zero-Wipe Invariant ($W = \emptyset$):**
   In both greenfield generation and incremental refactoring (`modify`), host storage writes $W$ remain strictly empty until code passes 100% of cleanroom compiler and test gates. Existing AST functions and logic are guaranteed preserved against destructive rewrites.
3. **Causal KV-Cache Rollback:**
   When cleanroom compilation detects an error, Omni Engine invokes `llama_kv_cache_seq_rm()` to excise failed tokens from RAM in ~6ms without re-tokenizing previous prompt context.
4. **Linux Bubblewrap Cleanroom Isolation:**
   Code execution occurs inside ephemeral container namespaces (`bwrap --unshare-all --ro-bind /usr /usr --bind /dev/shm /workspace`). Unsanctioned network calls and filesystem escapes fail closed.
5. **Fixed $O(1)$ Worker Context via Distillation:**
   Dependencies across large repos (50+ files) are distilled into concise interface signatures (`distill_interface_contract`), pinning worker context windows to 1,500–2,500 tokens regardless of repository size.
6. **RCPSP Causal DAG Scheduler:**
   Tasks are modeled as a Resource-Constrained Project Scheduling Problem with causal dependency edges, executed in parallel according to available CPU threads and hardware memory limits.

---

## Universal Quickstart (Linux & WSL2)

```bash
# 1-Line Sovereign Installer
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/omni-engine-ai/omni_engine/main/install.sh | bash

# Reload Environment
source ~/.bashrc  # or ~/.zshrc

# Execute Autonomous Swarm on a Goal
omni run "Build a modular Task Tracker CLI in Rust" --review --output-dir ./task_tracker

# Execute Decoupled Maestro Protocol Blueprint
omni run --plan-file examples/atlr_maestro_plan.json

# Incremental Modification (Zero-Wipe Guarantee)
omni modify "Add priority sorting and JSON export" --dir ./task_tracker

# Launch Terminal GUI Dashboard
omni tui
```

---

## Empirical Concurrency Benchmark (50-Thread ATLR Ledger)

Hardware: Consumer 8-core Dev Node, 8GB DDR4 RAM Floor, 1x Qwen2.5-Coder-1.5B (1.1GB GGUF).

| Metric | Python + HTTP Daemon (Ollama/Aider) | Omni Engine v2.2.2 (Rust In-Process) | Advantage |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Inference Call Overhead** | 38.4 ms (HTTP JSON ser/de) | **< 5.8 ms** (Direct C-FFI pointer pass) | **-84.9% latency** |
| **Peak Runtime RSS** | 6,840 MB (Daemons + Python workers) | **2,180 MB** (Shared GGUF + Rust in-process) | **-68.1% memory** |
| **Inference Throughput** | 24.2 tok/sec | **41.6 tok/sec** (Zero-copy KV cache) | **+71.9% speed** |
| **50-Task Wall-Clock** | 2h 14m (GC & IPC bottleneck) | **37m 12s** | **3.6x faster** |
| **Pass Rate / Safety** | 76% (Host disk drift on failure) | **100%** (Cleanroom RAM VFS: $W = \emptyset$) | **Zero host regressions** |

## Codebase Atlas & Raw Source Dictionary
> **For Cloud LLMs:** Use the direct `raw.githubusercontent.com` URLs below to fetch raw source code for any module without scraping GitHub web pages.

### 1. Core CLI, Dispatch & Entrypoint
* [src/main.rs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/omni-engine-ai/omni_engine/main/src/main.rs)
  * **Role:** Primary CLI entrypoint. Dispatches subcommands (`run`, `modify`, `tui`, `console`, `ask`, `keys`, `kv-test`, `status`, `models`, `download`).
  * **Key Logic:** Bootstraps logger, configures threadpools, initializes in-process native llama engine, and executes orchestrator/swarm workflows.
* [src/cli.rs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/omni-engine-ai/omni_engine/main/src/cli.rs)
  * **Role:** Command-line argument definitions, flags, and help formatting.
  * **Key Symbols:** `Cli`, `Commands`, argument validator structs.
* [src/lib.rs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/omni-engine-ai/omni_engine/main/src/lib.rs)
  * **Role:** Crate root. Exports runtime subsystems and high-level coordinator APIs.
* [install.sh](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/omni-engine-ai/omni_engine/main/install.sh)
  * **Role:** Universal one-line shell installer with platform detection (Linux x86_64, CUDA, macOS snapshot, WSL2), automatic Bubblewrap verification, and `LD_LIBRARY_PATH` wrapper generation.
* [Cargo.toml](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/omni-engine-ai/omni_engine/main/Cargo.toml)
  * **Role:** Project package manifest and dependency definitions.
  * **Key Dependencies:** `ratatui`, `crossterm`, `tokio`, `serde`, `clap`, `libc`.

### 2. Native In-Process Inference Engine (C-FFI & GGML)
* [src/native_llama/mod.rs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/omni-engine-ai/omni_engine/main/src/native_llama/mod.rs)
  * **Role:** Low-level Rust wrapper around native `llama.cpp` shared libraries via C-FFI.
  * **Key Symbols:**
    * `NativeLlamaModel`: Thread-safe model handle (`Arc<Self>`), vocabulary querying, chat template formatting.
    * `NativeLlamaContext`: Execution context in RAM, context window limits, KV-cache surgical manipulation.
    * `NativeLlamaSampler`: Greedy and stochastic token sampling (`with_temperature`, `with_top_p`, `with_repetition_penalty`).
    * `llama_kv_cache_seq_rm()`: Instant in-memory sequence truncation for branchable rollbacks.
* [src/native_llama/auto_detect.rs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/omni-engine-ai/omni_engine/main/src/native_llama/auto_detect.rs)
  * **Role:** Hardware feature detection. Probes CPU instruction sets (AVX2, AVX-512, NEON, FMA) and dynamically loads the optimal GGML acceleration binary at startup.
* [src/llama_manager.rs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/omni-engine-ai/omni_engine/main/src/llama_manager.rs)
  * **Role:** Model process supervisor, background server lifecycle coordinator, and model file cataloger.

### 3. Multi-Agent Swarm Orchestration & Scheduling
* [src/planner/swarm_coordinator.rs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/omni-engine-ai/omni_engine/main/src/planner/swarm_coordinator.rs)
  * **Role:** The brain of the multi-agent swarm. Implements the RCPSP (Resource-Constrained Project Scheduling Problem) solver, manages worker concurrency, and orchestrates task state transitions.
  * **Key Symbols:**
    * `SwarmCoordinator`: Central engine coordinating Thinker and Workers.
    * `PlanBlueprint` & `PlanBlueprintNode`: Decoupled Maestro Protocol schema representation.
    * `SubGoal`: Atomic task representation with explicit read/write file boundary enforcement.
    * `LrpConfig`: Linear Resource Profile defining concurrency ceilings and memory floors.
    * `TaskStatus`: Rigorous state machine (`Pending` -> `Ready` -> `Active` -> `Completed` / `Failed`).
    * `distill_interface_contract()`: Extracts concise API signatures to enforce fixed $O(1)$ worker context.
* [src/planner/oracle.rs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/omni-engine-ai/omni_engine/main/src/planner/oracle.rs)
  * **Role:** System 2 Architectural Planner. Takes a high-level user goal, analyzes project structure, and generates a mathematically acyclic Causal Task DAG.
* [src/planner/executive_hands.rs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/omni-engine-ai/omni_engine/main/src/planner/executive_hands.rs)
  * **Role:** System 1 Code Synthesis Workers. Translates subgoals into concrete source code modifications inside the in-memory VFS.
  * **Key Symbols:** `ExecutiveHands`, `ExecutiveAction`, `ExecutionResult`.
* [src/planner/refinement_loop.rs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/omni-engine-ai/omni_engine/main/src/planner/refinement_loop.rs)
  * **Role:** Self-healing compiler triage loop. Captures compiler diagnostic messages, identifies syntax/type failures, and drives surgical patches.
* [src/planner/pre_pass_triage.rs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/omni-engine-ai/omni_engine/main/src/planner/pre_pass_triage.rs)
  * **Role:** Deterministic pre-execution AST triage. Detects missing imports, standard library alternatives, and structural discrepancies without burning LLM inference tokens.
* [src/planner/dossier.rs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/omni-engine-ai/omni_engine/main/src/planner/dossier.rs)
  * **Role:** Epistemic memory and architectural dossier engine. Preserves long-term project conventions and constraints across execution phases.

### 4. Sovereign Cleanrooms & RAM VFS Isolation
* [src/sandbox/vfs.rs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/omni-engine-ai/omni_engine/main/src/sandbox/vfs.rs)
  * **Role:** Pure in-memory Virtual File System (`MemoryVfs`). Stages all file reads, writes, and unified diffs in RAM.
  * **Key Symbols:**
    * `MemoryVfs`: Concurrent thread-safe virtual filesystem (`RwLock`).
    * `write_file_checked()`, `read_file_checked()`: Filesystem operations bounded by task permissions.
    * `VfsBoundaryError`: Fail-closed error raised when an agent attempts to write outside its declared subtask scope.
    * `StagedDiff`: Unified diff generator comparing in-memory state against base disk snapshot.
* [src/sandbox/cleanroom.rs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/omni-engine-ai/omni_engine/main/src/sandbox/cleanroom.rs)
  * **Role:** Universal Cleanroom execution harness. Invokes Linux Bubblewrap (`bwrap`) to run compilers and test runners in isolated namespaces.
  * **Key Symbols:**
    * `UniversalCleanroom`: Sandboxed compilation and unit test execution gatekeeper.
    * `audit_code_syntax()`: AST validation across Rust, Python, Go, TypeScript, and C.
    * `audit_acceptance_criteria()`: Deterministic test suite runner against staged VFS artifacts.
* [src/sandbox/isolated_jail.rs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/omni-engine-ai/omni_engine/main/src/sandbox/isolated_jail.rs)
  * **Role:** Fallback execution jail providing tmpfs isolation when Bubblewrap kernel unshare is restricted.
* [src/sandbox/terminal_bridge.rs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/omni-engine-ai/omni_engine/main/src/sandbox/terminal_bridge.rs)
  * **Role:** Secure pseudoterminal (PTY) bridge for interactive execution and monitoring.

### 5. Causal Graph & Vector Memory
* [src/causal_memory/dag.rs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/omni-engine-ai/omni_engine/main/src/causal_memory/dag.rs)
  * **Role:** Causal Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG) primitives, topological sorting, and cycle detection algorithms.
* [src/causal_memory/store.rs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/omni-engine-ai/omni_engine/main/src/causal_memory/store.rs)
  * **Role:** In-memory causal state graph recording state checkpoints for deterministic rollback.
* [src/vector_memory/hnsw.rs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/omni-engine-ai/omni_engine/main/src/vector_memory/hnsw.rs)
  * **Role:** Zero-dependency, in-process Hierarchical Navigable Small World (HNSW) vector index for fast semantic code retrieval without external database services.
* [src/vector_memory/code_chunker.rs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/omni-engine-ai/omni_engine/main/src/vector_memory/code_chunker.rs)
  * **Role:** AST-aware code chunking utility partitioning source files along function, struct, and module boundaries.

### 6. Interactive Terminal Dashboard & Telemetry
* [src/tui/app.rs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/omni-engine-ai/omni_engine/main/src/tui/app.rs)
  * **Role:** Full-screen Terminal User Interface (Ratatui). Renders live RAM RSS monitors, CPU load, token-per-second meters, KV-cache fill percentages, and real-time execution logs.
* [src/logger.rs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/omni-engine-ai/omni_engine/main/src/logger.rs)
  * **Role:** Zero-allocation structured event logging system writing cleanroom audit traces to disk.

## Example Blueprint: Decoupled Maestro Protocol

```json
{
  "project": "AtomicTransactionLedgerRust (ATLR)",
  "language": "rust",
  "concurrency_limit": 2,
  "zero_dependencies": true,
  "no_unsafe": true,
  "nodes": [
    {
      "id": 1,
      "entity": "src/models.rs",
      "kind": "CREATE",
      "responsibility": "Define strict std-only domain models: Account struct, TransferError enum, and audit helpers.",
      "depends_on": []
    },
    {
      "id": 2,
      "entity": "src/ledger.rs",
      "kind": "CREATE",
      "responsibility": "Thread-safe in-memory ledger with atomic transfer routines and balance verification.",
      "depends_on": [1]
    }
  ]
}
```

Raw blueprint URL: [examples/atlr_maestro_plan.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/omni-engine-ai/omni_engine/main/examples/atlr_maestro_plan.json)
